title: CLIO vs. Claude Code on HPC topology-optimization workflows: official thesis experiments E1–E3 (data and automation)
description: Counted trials of three experiments (E1 uninterrupted, E2 interrupted recovery, E3 distributed context) comparing a headless Claude Code baseline with CLIO (factorio-flat 0.5.0) on frozen Morphorm topology-optimization workflows on CHPC notchpeak, model claude-fable-5-1, five counted trials per arm per experiment. Includes automation, frozen task packets (without the Morphorm manuals), per-trial records, scores, telemetry tables, analysis scripts, figures, methods notes and a run guide. Code: MIT. Data, documents and figures: CC BY 4.0.
